notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
- Added Survival mode clear achievement.
- Destroying monsters in Survival Mode now correctly reflects Destroyer achievements.
- You can no longer have more than 999 cores in Survival mode.
- Changed the character selection UI.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
- Clearing the Singleplayer Stage now gives you a chance to earn Radial Core.
- Added upgrade system. You can upgrade using Radical Core.
- You can change the skin of the character. You can purchase skins with Radical Core.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
- Now combat will start with active skill and evasion skill.
- The difficulty of some stages has become easier.
